lessons: Assume she follows through best in early-morning windows around her stated intention (06:30-07:00) and in the habitual 17:30-19:00 slot on dry evenings. Midday shows low self-efficacy, so avoid it for effortful tasks. Weekends have long free blocks and good outdoor conditions, suiting the long walk. Short, low-intensity tasks go in morning slots; the intense cardio goes at the habitual evening time before the rain.
